title: 第4 章 下馆子-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王主任听完周主任的话，边走边嘟囔：“这给你狂的，一天天就会使唤我，我是催巴儿呀？”

    周主任也不接话，王野看着王主任走出办公室，转头对周主任说：“周叔，多了，这点儿东西换不了你给的这些，何况还给白面。”

    周主任摆摆手：“没事儿，咱这食品厂不缺这点东西，小野呀，你这甲鱼黄鳝可帮了叔大忙了，今天咱食品厂接待上面的领导，要不是你这甲鱼，你周叔是一个拿得出手的菜都没有呀。”

    顿了一下，周主任继续说：“你要觉得给的多，以后有什么好东西给周叔多送点儿，叔绝不让你吃亏，你也应该知道像咱这种厂子迎来送往的不断，可咱现在是连点荤腥都没有。”

    周主任叹了口气：“小野，你是不知道呀，我在肉联厂蹲了一个礼拜了，这真是不管多大官，你到了肉联厂都得装孙子。”

    王野看着周主任的样子，也知道这是为了让自己安心接受：“行，周叔，您话都说到这份上了，我也就不客气了，咱来日方长。”

    王主任拿着一个小布袋子，和一个罐头瓶子回到办公室，把罐头瓶子和面袋子放在茶几上也不说话。

    周主任从办公桌抽屉里拿出三张大黑十和一小打票据，和收购证明递给王野，王野接过钱：“周叔，王大爷，我们就不打扰了，得赶紧回家了。”

    “好好，我送你们出去，你们路上慢点，没事儿来玩儿。”周主任起身带着王野三个出了食品厂。

    王野背着小丫头，王江河背着小面口袋，向家里走去。慢慢悠悠走到南锣鼓巷胡同口。

    看着路口的国营饭店，王野实在走不动了。这回来的路都是靠意志坚持的。一个半大小子就早上喝了一碗糊糊，又忙活了一上午，早就饿得前胸贴后背了。

    “走，大哥带你们去下馆子。”

    王江河兴奋地蹦了起来：“大哥真的吗？真带我们下馆子。”

    王野被王江河兴奋的情绪感染了几分：“真的，比真金还真。”

    带着弟弟妹妹走进国营饭店。

    一个前台后面站着一个三十多岁的妇女，无聊地织着毛衣。抬眼看见一个半大小子带着两个小孩儿，又低下头继续织着毛衣说：“小孩儿，你要什么？”

    “姨，咱这儿有什么呀？”王野客气地问。

    不客气不行呀。知道什么是八大员吗，售票员、驾驶员、邮递员、保育员、理发员、服务员、售货员、炊事员。这是工作的天花板，有一个算一个，都牛气得很。

    不看饭店墙上贴着标语“不得无故殴打顾客”。什么叫不得无故殴打顾客，就是有理由可以随便打。就这饭店里，你要敢放肆，后厨大师傅就敢抄着菜刀出来干你。

    前台妇女头都不抬，指了指墙上的黑板，王野顺着方向看见墙上挂着一个黑板。

    上面写着，醋溜土豆丝，素炒豆芽菜，白菜炖粉条，萝卜素丸子，疙瘩汤，酸辣汤，二合面馒头，素包子连主食带汤一共就八道菜，全是素的，肉就不要想了，不说有没有肉，就算有也只会给熟人留着。

    “姨，给我们来个土豆丝，再来个白菜炖粉条，再来个疙瘩汤，再来六个馒头。”

    前台妇女略想片刻：“醋溜土豆丝两毛，白菜炖粉条三毛，疙瘩汤两毛，二合面馒头两分，二两粮票，一共八毛二分加一斤二两粮票。”

    给了钱和票，带着弟弟妹妹到了一个桌子边坐下，抱着妹妹，旁边王江河小心翼翼地坐在凳子上，这是王江河第一次下馆子。

    没一会儿，墙上出餐口响起一声吆喝声：“端菜！”

After listening to what Director Zhou said, Director Wang muttered as he walked: "You are crazy, you will call me around every day, am I a nudge?"

Director Zhou didn't answer. Wang Ye watched Director Wang walk out of the office, turned to Director Zhou and said, "Uncle Zhou, it's too much. This little thing can't replace what you gave me, let alone the white noodles."

Director Zhou waved his hand: "It's okay, our food factory is not short of these things, Xiaoye, your soft-shelled turtle and eel have helped uncle a lot. Our food factory received the leaders above today. If it weren't for your soft-shelled turtle, your uncle Zhou wouldn't have even a single dish that he could handle."

After a pause, Director Zhou continued: "If you feel that the gift is enough, if you have any good things to give to Uncle Zhou in the future, I will never let you suffer. You should also know that a factory like ours is constantly receiving gifts, but now we don't even have any meat."

Director Zhou sighed: "Xiaoye, you don't know, I have been squatting in the meat factory for a week. It really doesn't matter how high you are, you have to pretend to be a grandson when you get to the meat factory."

Wang Ye looked at Director Zhou and knew that this was to allow him to accept it with peace of mind: "Okay, Uncle Zhou, you have said this, so I won't be polite. We have a long time ahead."

Director Wang returned to the office with a small cloth bag and a can, and placed the can and flour bag on the coffee table without saying a word.

Director Zhou took out three big black tens and a small dozen bills from the desk drawer, and handed them the purchase certificate to Wang Ye. Wang Ye took the money: "Uncle Zhou, Uncle Wang, we won't disturb you, we have to go home quickly."

"Okay, I'll take you out. Slow down on the road. Come and play if you have nothing to do." Director Zhou got up and led Wang Ye and the others out of the food factory.

Wang Ye carried the little girl on his back, and Wang Jianghe carried the small flour bag on his back, walking towards home.Walk slowly and leisurely to the entrance of Nanluoguxiang alley.

Looking at the state-owned hotel at the intersection, Wang Ye couldn't walk anymore.The journey back is all determined by will.The young man drank a bowl of glutinous rice paste in the morning and worked hard all morning. He was so hungry that his chest pressed against his back.

"Let's go, big brother will take you to a restaurant."

Wang Jianghe jumped up excitedly: "Brother, are you serious? You're really taking us to a restaurant."

Wang Ye was somewhat infected by Wang Jianghe's excitement: "Really, it's more real than real gold."

We walked into the state-owned hotel with our younger brothers and sisters.

A woman in her thirties stood behind a front desk, knitting a sweater boredly.He looked up and saw a half-grown man with two children. He lowered his head and continued to knit a sweater and said, "Children, what do you want?"

"Auntie, what do we have here?" Wang Ye asked politely.

You’re welcome.Do you know what the eight members are, conductor, driver, postman, childcare worker, hairdresser, waiter, salesperson, and cook?This is the ceiling of work. Every one of them is very arrogant.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​What is meant by not beating customers without reason is that they can be beaten casually if there is a reason.In this restaurant, if you dare to act recklessly, the chef will come out and fuck you with a kitchen knife.

The woman at the front desk pointed to the blackboard on the wall without raising her head. Wang Ye followed the direction and saw a blackboard hanging on the wall.

It says: Vinegar shredded potatoes, vegetarian stir-fried bean sprouts, cabbage stewed vermicelli, vegetarian radish meatballs, pimple soup, hot and sour soup, steamed buns with noodles, vegetarian steamed buns with soup, a total of eight dishes. They are all vegetarian. Don’t think about the meat. It doesn’t matter whether there is meat or not. Even if there is, it will only be reserved for acquaintances.

"Auntie, give us some shredded potatoes, some cabbage stewed with vermicelli, some pimple soup, and some six steamed buns."

The woman at the front desk thought for a moment: "Two cents for shredded potatoes with vinegar, three cents for stewed vermicelli with cabbage, two cents for pimple soup, two cents for two-faced steamed buns, and twenty taels of food stamps. A total of eight cents and two cents plus one pound and two taels of food stamps."

After giving the money and tickets, he took his younger brother and sister to a table and sat down, hugging his younger sister. Next to him, Wang Jianghe carefully sat on a stool. This was Wang Jianghe's first time in a restaurant.

After a while, a shout came from the dining outlet on the wall: "Bring the food!"
